entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?

Hi Isaac... I'm calling about an order. I bought a jersey a little while ago, and... I just don't think it's going to work out. I was hoping I could still return it. I've been a loyal customer for years and I really was counting on this working.

I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number? And just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

The order number is... VF78901. And it's not broken or anything, it's just... the wrong size. I thought I ordered the right one, but this one is just way too tight on me. I really needed the money back if I can't get an exchange.
Okay, I see. So the fit isn't right. Let me pull up your order, VF78901. I see the ProFit Jersey was delivered on December 10th. One moment while I review our return policy for that item.
Oh, has it been that long? I've been so busy... I was really hoping it wasn't too late. It's just been sitting here.

No problem at all. I've just checked, and you are well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. Since it's a sizing issue and the item is in its original condition, I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. We can process a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Would you prefer to do that, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
I think I'll just take the refund for now. Thank you! You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. The email has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help, Isaac!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
